newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up, tracking strong crude prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up, tracking strong crude prices.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Tuesday firmed by at least $3 per tonne, tracking strong crude prices, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $128 per tonne by most majors and 380-cst at $124 per tonne. Independents were quoting a shade lower at $125 per tonne for 180-cst and at $121 for 380-cst.
On Monday, bunker 180-cst was quoted at $120/$122 and 380 cst at $115-$117. Traders said enquiries were average and the strong European market has also placed firm sentiment.
MDO prices stayed steady, indicated at $210-$220, and gas oil was steady at $230-$235. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
